tasks.name: battle_zone
tasks.historical_source:
The mechanics, lives, bonus threshold, and target values follow Atari's instruction manual for
the Atari 2600 version of *Battlezone*.

tasks.name: zaxxon
tasks.historical_source:
The inverted altitude controls, energy blasts, four skill levels, fortress-space-fortress sequence,
fuel drain and tanks, barriers, ground and air enemies, stopped boss encounter, vulnerable missile,
three skill-one hits, all target values, five fighters, and reinforcement follow Coleco's Atari
2600 *Zaxxon* manual as transcribed by AtariAge:
https://www.atariage.com/manual_html_page.php?SoftwareLabelID=606.

tasks.name: skiing
tasks.historical_source:
The slalom/downhill modes, Game 4's 50 gates, fixed and generated courses, controls, ski angles,
turn-dependent speed, gates, five-second missed-gate penalty, trees and moguls, recovery after
falls, timer, reset button, and racing-line strategy follow Activision's Atari 2600 *Skiing*
manual by Bob Whitehead, archived by AtariAge.

tasks.name: phoenix
tasks.historical_source:
The four bird flocks and mothership cycle, five lives, controls, one-shot rule, force-field timing,
small-bird swoop values, large-bird wing regeneration and proximity values, layered rotating hull,
and rising mothership award follow Atari's Atari 2600 *Phoenix* manual archived by AtariAge.

tasks.name: montezumas_revenge
tasks.historical_source:
The objective, three difficulty levels, five starting Panama Joes, inventory, tools, rewards,
creatures, room fixtures, deaths, extra-life rule, and point values follow Parker Brothers'
Atari 2600 *Montezuma's Revenge* manual archived in HTML by AtariAge and as a scanned manual by
RetroGames.cz.

tasks.name: kung_fu_master
tasks.historical_source:
The five floors and bosses, faster restart, movement and stances, punch/kick distinctions,
henchman grabs, knife heights, midgets, dragon balls, baskets/snakes, moths, energy and timer,
floor bonuses, enemy and boss values, three lives, and 75,000-point extra life follow Activision's
Atari 2600 *Kung-Fu Master* manual archived by AtariAge.

tasks.name: assault
tasks.historical_source: The mechanics mapping follows Bomb/Onbase's Atari 2600 instruction manual for *Assault*.

tasks.name: video_pinball
tasks.historical_source:
The object, three balls, extra-ball rule, flippers, plunger, nudge/tilt, all devices and exact
scores, multiplier, 4,000-point left-rollover limit, four-second special, one-extra-ball limit,
game-one bumper accumulation, and drain bonus follow Atari's 1981 *Video Pinball* manual:
https://www.digitpress.com/library/manuals/atari2600/video_pinball.pdf.

tasks.name: hero
tasks.historical_source:
The prop-pack controls, gravity descent, six dynamite sticks, microlaser wall cutting, raft,
lantern, lava and critter hazards, power loss, 20 rescue levels, four lives, extra-life threshold,
and scoring follow Activision's Atari 2600 *H.E.R.O.* manual archived by AtariAge.

tasks.name: kangaroo
tasks.historical_source:
The three-screen rounds, three starting lives, ladders, broken-log super leaps, jump and duck
responses, punching, four monkeys, thrown and falling apple values, three fruit, three bell rings,
fruit value ladder, 2,000-point timer, 20,000-point bonus lives, and rescue rules follow Atari's
Atari 2600 *Kangaroo* manual archived by AtariAge.

tasks.name: star_gunner
tasks.historical_source:
The controls and difficulty behavior, single-shot trigger, alien disintegration/rematerialization,
three waves, counts and concurrency, endless level escalation, five ships, three loss causes,
10,000-point reinforcements, scoring, bonuses, Bobo bombs, and game variations follow Telesys's
Atari 2600 *Star Gunner* manual.

tasks.name: yars_revenge
tasks.historical_source:
The objective, shield methods, cannon charging and self-danger, Qotile weapons, Neutral Zone,
four lives, vertical wrapping, shared fire control, normal-game variation, and exact scoring follow
Atari's 1982 *Yars' Revenge* manual as transcribed by AtariAge:
https://atariage.com/manual_html_page.php?SoftwareLabelID=603.

tasks.name: pitfall
tasks.historical_source:
The 32 treasures and values, perfect score, 2,000 starting score, three lives, 20-minute limit,
surface/tunnel maze, three-screen shortcuts, controls, vines, ladders, hazards, 100-point holes,
and log deductions follow Activision's Atari 2600 *Pitfall!* manual archived by AtariAge.

tasks.name: tutankham
tasks.historical_source:
The objective, joystick and horizontal-fire controls, fire-plus-up flash, three lives and flashes,
keys, nests, treasures, passages, ammunition band, exit condition, four chambers, four difficulty
levels, scoring table, and ammunition bonus follow Parker Brothers' 1983 Atari 2600 *Tutankham*
manual as transcribed by AtariAge: https://atariage.com/manual_html_page.php?SoftwareLabelID=572.

tasks.name: defender
tasks.historical_source:
The alien roles and values, five Humanoids, rescue awards, survivor bonus, Mutant takeover and
fifth-wave rebirth, contextual fire controls, smart bombs, safe Atari hyperspace, self-sacrifice,
and 10,000-point bonuses follow Atari's *Defender* instruction manual archived by AtariAge.

tasks.name: frostbite
tasks.historical_source:
The four-row color cycle, igloo construction, reversal cost, animal and bear hazards, fish value,
45-degree countdown, four starting lives, 5,000-point reserves, level score table, entry award,
and temperature formula follow Activision's Atari 2600 *Frostbite* manual archived by AtariAge.

tasks.name: james_bond
tasks.historical_source:
The three missions and objectives, multipurpose craft, jump/dive return, alternating weapons,
diamond illumination, oil-rig landing, three spinning satellites, transforming shuttles and
rockets, submarines, torpedoes, laboratory bombing, timed capsule rescue, target values, 5,000
mission award, retained craft, and game-over rules follow Parker Brothers' Atari 2600
*James Bond 007* manual archived by AtariAge.

tasks.name: gopher
tasks.historical_source:
The three carrots, tunnel-filling score, surface bonk, carrot theft, accelerating gopher, and
duck-delivered replacement seed follow the Atari 2600 *Gopher* manual archived by AtariAge.

tasks.name: venture
tasks.historical_source:
The two-scale hall/chamber structure, free room order, treasure lockout, arrow controls,
invulnerable Hallmonsters, post-treasure monster scoring, lethal corpses, room timeout, Wall Room,
four lives, and deeper halls follow Atari's 2600 *Venture* manual and Coleco guide:
https://atariage.com/manual_html_page.php?SoftwareLabelID=576 and
https://www.ataricompendium.com/archives/manuals/vcs/venture.pdf. The score multipliers are
corroborated by contemporary cartridge documentation and the Atari 2600 game guide.

tasks.name: solaris
tasks.historical_source:
The mission, scanner sectors and exits, focus-dependent warp fuel, three fighters, fuel and docking,
Federation defense timer, Red Zones, controls, targeting computer, Zylon planets, corridors,
enemy classes and values, 8,000-point bonuses, reinforcements, and terminal conditions follow
Atari's *Solaris* manual archived by AtariAge.

tasks.name: bank_heist
tasks.historical_source:
The mechanics, bank values, cop values, and first-level town bonuses follow 20th Century Fox's
Atari 2600 instruction manual for *Bank Heist*.

tasks.name: amidar
tasks.historical_source: The mechanics mapping follows the Parker Brothers Atari 2600 instruction manual for *Amidar*.

tasks.name: time_pilot
tasks.historical_source:
The flight and fire controls, five time periods and enemy families, 56-aircraft quota, era-specific
weapons, formations, heavy aircraft, seven-hit mother ships, time travel, and score values follow
Konami's *Time Pilot* arcade service manual and the Coleco Atari 2600 conversion description. The
2600 port's omitted parachutists are corroborated by contemporary port documentation and review.

tasks.name: gravitar
tasks.historical_source:
The 12 solar systems, planet-or-reactor completion routes, gravity and reverse-gravity galaxies,
terrain collision, bunkers, shield, tractor beam, 5,000-unit depots, 10,000 starting fuel, reactor
countdown, system awards, scoring values, bonus ships, and game-over rules follow Atari's Atari
2600 *Gravitar* manual archived by AtariAge.

tasks.name: wizard_of_wor
tasks.historical_source:
The objective, three Worriors, one-shot laser, 10,000-point reinforcement, enemy order and traits,
Worluk appearance and doubling, Wizard teleport battle, radar, escape doors, and exact point values
follow CBS's 1982 Atari 2600 *Wizard of Wor* manual as transcribed by AtariAge:
https://atariage.com/manual_html_page.php?SoftwareLabelID=598.

tasks.name: asteroids
tasks.historical_source:
The mechanics and point values follow Atari's instruction manual for the Atari 2600 version of
*Asteroids*.

tasks.name: double_dunk
tasks.historical_source:
The two player roles, play sequencing, jump-release timing, dunks, three-point and foul scoring,
steals, blocks, rebounding, clear-the-arc rule, shot clock, lane violation, and game-length option
follow Atari's *Double Dunk* instruction manual archived by AtariAge.

tasks.name: centipede
tasks.historical_source:
The segment splitting, mushroom durability, insect values, poisoned dives, player zone, wave
composition, and life-loss mushroom scoring follow Atari's *Centipede* Atari 2600 instruction
manual archived by AtariAge.

tasks.name: road_runner
tasks.historical_source:
The eight levels, controls, three lives, seed escalation/reset, steel shot and magnet behavior,
hazards, point values, and double-back strategy follow Atari's Atari 2600 *Road Runner* manual
archived by AtariAge.

tasks.name: atlantis
tasks.historical_source: The mechanics and scoring follow Imagic's Atari 2600 instruction manual for *Atlantis*.

tasks.name: bowling
tasks.historical_source:
The controls, variations, frame structure, and scoring follow Atari's instruction manual for the
Atari 2600 version of *Bowling*.

tasks.name: crazy_climber
tasks.historical_source:
The five climbers, two-hand window rules, braced-object protection, unavoidable girders,
electric-sign shocks, helicopter timer, four-building point values, and maximum bonuses follow
Atari's *Crazy Climber* instruction manual archived by AtariAge.

tasks.name: boxing
tasks.historical_source:
The controls, two-minute bout, jab/power values, and K.O. rule follow Activision's Atari 2600
instruction manual for *Boxing*.

tasks.name: demon_attack
tasks.historical_source:
The movement controls, unlimited cannon, three starting bunkers, unscathed-wave reserve award,
post-zero fatal hit, split and diving enemies, asymmetric child fire, and every score tier follow
Imagic's Atari 2600 *Demon Attack* instruction manual archived by AtariAge.

tasks.name: enduro
tasks.historical_source:
The accelerator/coast/brake controls, collision consequences, first-day 200 and later-day 300
quotas, post-quota progress, sunrise failure, day/night cues, ice steering, and fog visibility
follow Activision's Atari 2600 *Enduro* instruction manual archived by AtariAge.

tasks.name: ice_hockey
tasks.historical_source:
The three-minute period, two skaters per team, nearest-skater automatic control, puck capture,
forward-only timing-based shot angles, passing, bank shots, body checks, faceoffs, goalie defense,
and one-point goals follow Activision's Atari 2600 *Ice Hockey* manual archived by AtariAge.

tasks.name: tennis
tasks.historical_source:
The game variations, controls, movement restrictions, orange opening serve, server and side changes,
automatic swings, guaranteed in-bounds serves and shots, net-shot length and angles, racket-edge
placement, point/game scoring, deuce/advantage, two-game margin, 6–6 reset, and tactical guidance
follow Activision's Atari 2600 *Tennis* manual by Alan Miller, archived by AtariAge.

tasks.name: krull
tasks.historical_source:
The marriage defense, speed-scaled Slayers, Fire Mare pickups, Glaives and extra lives, Widow's
web, strand and cocoon scores, Crystal Spider timer, sunrise-dependent paths, failure costs,
Glaive steering/rebound/catch rules, prison chunks, Lyssa's fireball, Beast value, harder restart,
and three starting lives follow Atari's Atari 2600 *Krull* manual archived by AtariAge.

tasks.name: name_this_game
tasks.historical_source:
The treasure-defense objective, left/right and fire controls, shark depth scoring, 50-point
tentacles, moving oxygen line, ten-point full-tank air units, loss conditions, and faster later
waves follow U.S. Games' Atari 2600 *Name This Game* manual archived by AtariAge.

tasks.name: robot_tank
tasks.historical_source:
The controls, destroyed-tank scoring, twelve 12-tank squadrons, starting reserves and squadron
reinforcements, terminal conditions, first-person view, clock, weather, radar, four damage systems,
targetable cannon fire, and rocket interception follow Activision's 1983 *Robot Tank* manual by
Alan Miller, archived by AtariAge.

tasks.name: berzerk
tasks.historical_source:
The mechanics and scoring follow Atari's instruction manual for the Atari 2600 version of
*Berzerk*.

tasks.name: beam_rider
tasks.historical_source:
The mechanics and sector progression follow Activision's Atari 2600 instruction manual for
*Beamrider*.

tasks.name: fishing_derby
tasks.historical_source:
The line controls, six fish rows, 2/4/6-pound values, original-side respawn, slow/fast reeling,
shark interception, two-fisher competition, and 99-pound finish follow Activision's Atari 2600
*Fishing Derby* instruction manual archived by AtariAge.

tasks.name: up_n_down
tasks.historical_source:
The forward/reverse controls, branch steering, forward-only straight jump, broken-road jumps,
five/easy and three/hard lives, eight flags, nine roads, collision rules, opponent types, prizes,
and every score value follow Sega's 1984 Atari 2600 *Up 'n Down* manual as transcribed by AtariAge:
https://atariage.com/manual_html_page.php?SoftwareID=1423.

tasks.name: private_eye
tasks.historical_source:
The five cases, Case 5 aggregation, city search, one-item rule, evidence/property requirements,
questionable characters, Model A controls, passages, obstacles, dagger drops, merit/demerit table,
and booking sequence follow Activision's Atari 2600 *Private Eye* manual archived by AtariAge and
Digital Press.

tasks.name: alien
tasks.historical_source:
The maze objective, eggs, three pursuing Aliens, three Pulsars, vulnerability window, collision
loss, and egg-clear progression follow 20th Century Fox's Atari 2600 *Alien* manual as transcribed
by AtariAge: https://atariage.com/manual_html_page.php?SoftwareID=815.

tasks.name: ms_pac_man
tasks.historical_source:
The maze-clearing objective, three lives, first-10,000 bonus life, four ghosts, dots, energizers,
fruit sequence, frightened chain, tunnels, multiple mazes, and point values follow Atari's Atari
2600 *Ms. Pac-Man* manual archived by AtariAge.

tasks.name: chopper_command
tasks.historical_source:
The convoy objective, scanner, 12-aircraft/12-truck waves, ten-wave progression, split missiles,
scoring values, wave-bonus formula, ammunition, reserves, and extra-life rule follow Activision's
Atari 2600 *Chopper Command* instruction manual archived by AtariAge.

tasks.name: adventure
tasks.historical_source:
The mechanics mapping follows Atari's instruction manual for the Atari 2600 version of
*Adventure*.

tasks.name: river_raid
tasks.historical_source:
The mission, target values, river sections, bridges, fuel behavior, throttle/refueling tradeoff,
traffic, controls, three reserve jets, and 10,000-point reinforcements follow Activision's Atari
2600 *River Raid* manual archived by AtariAge.

tasks.name: qbert
tasks.historical_source:
The pyramid objective, controls, five-by-four round structure, four lives, five color rules,
creatures, discs, bonus-life schedule, 25/300/100/500 values, and 3,100 round bonus follow the
Atari 2600 *Q*bert* manual archived by AtariAge.
